messages:
mike (eng-platform): quick sync — we need a concrete emitter + sampling plan for per-model/route SLO dashboards (p50/p95/p99 latency, TTFT, tokens/sec). Who owns schema and where does rollup happen?

anya (eng-runtime): I can own the emitter schema. proposal: emit raw request events with these fields: `model`, `route`, `region`, `instance_id`, `seq_len`, `cache_hit`, `latency_ms`, `ttft_ms`, `tokens`. default sampling on emitter.

lee (eng-infra): big :warning: on cardinality. instance_id + route + model + region will explode. we should never ship raw instance_id to long-term metrics. we can emit instance-level for short TTL (1h) and rollup to model+route+region for 30d.

sam (console): console needs consistent metric names and labels. want Prometheus-style rollups: p50/p95/p99 of `redwood_inference_request_latency_ms{model,route,region}` and `redwood_inference_ttft_ms{model,route}` plus `redwood_inference_tokens_per_sec{model,route}`. also want tokens/sec as rate over 1m and 5m.

anya (eng-runtime): agreed on names. emitter will stamp `redwood_event_request` events to the telemetry bus. example payload: ```json
{
  "model":"llama-3-70b",
  "route":"chat-completion",
  "region":"us-west-2",
  "cache_hit":false,
  "latency_ms":312,
  "ttft_ms":120,
  "tokens":128
}
```
we'll add `sample_rate` header so downstream know how to scale.

lee (eng-infra): for rollups we'll run a windowed aggregator in the metrics pipeline that computes per-model/route histograms and counters. pipeline config (pseudo):
```
input -> dedupe -> sample-rescale -> histogram-agg(window=1m, key=[model,route,region]) -> write(timeseries)
```
we can keep instance-level metrics in hotstore for 1h for debugging.

mike (eng-platform): how aggressive is sampling? cost constraints from finance: ingest budget caps for hosted API.

anya (eng-runtime): default emitter sample_rate = 1/1000 for all requests. we expose override per-customer and per-route via runtime config (e.g., critical routes can set 1/100). for canaries/rollouts we allow full sampling for the experiment traffic.

sam (console): with 1/1000 we lose tail for low-traffic models. Need deterministic override: allow `force_sample=true` for routes labelled `critical` or when `env=staging`. and provide a small SDK helper to mark eval/prompt-sets so console can request denser sampling for those trace IDs.

lee (eng-infra): suggestion: emit an additional boolean `is_eval` and `is_rollout_traffic`. pipeline can apply `if is_eval or is_rollout_traffic then keep_all` before sampling. also store sample_rate in metric labels that we rescale by.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: telemetry-emitter v2 -> canary on runtime-us-west-2 (ids: e1234).

anya (eng-runtime): one more: TTFT semantics — we must agree on components included. proposal: TTFT = client->accept + decode-init + first-token-emitted. excludes network egress from our edge. put definition in docs and surface as `ttft_ms` label docs.

mike (eng-platform): good call. console will show TTFT SLO by route. sam, finalize panels? give us the aggregation windows.

sam (console): panels will use 1m, 5m, 1h rollups. queries: p50/p95/p99 from histogram buckets for `redwood_inference_request_latency_ms` with `rate()` over 1m, TTFT as `redwood_inference_ttft_ms` with `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(...[5m])) by (le,model,route))`. tokens/sec panel: `sum(rate(redwood_inference_tokens_total[1m])) by (model,route)` divided by `sum(rate(redwood_inference_requests_total[1m])) by (model,route)`.

lee (eng-infra): we also need a quota signal: expose `redwood_inference_request_dropped_total{reason=~"quota|capacity"}` so dashboards can show fallback events when routing fires.

anya (eng-runtime): will add `dropped` event emission when fallback occurs with `reason` and `fallback_model`.

mike (eng-platform): action items: Anya produce emitter PR + schema doc, Lee produce pipeline rollup config + retention policy, Sam produce console panel JSON snippets. deadline EOD Friday. post back when PRs land. :thumbsup:

sam (console): adding one UX ask — when showing per-model SLOs, include a small line for 'routing policy applied' that shows percent of traffic routed to cheaper fallback model (label `routed_to`), so product can see quality/cost tradeoffs.

anya (eng-runtime): will emit label `routed_to` when routing overridden.

lee (eng-infra): final note — recommend storing histograms with base-2 exponential buckets for latency up to 30s to get reasonable p99 resolution.

mike (eng-platform): perfect. thanks team, this is the handoff we needed.
